purpose: Prospective test of the fixed32 ordinary predictor on304 fresh blocks, with the prior256-block feasibility failure preserved. No new model fitting or claim of RDT-specific novelty.

models.comparator: Frozen all512 retained_8 model chosen by previous full-development rule.
models.boundary_reference: Frozen all512 TT008. Repeat difference is structurally zero because B is fixed; this is not forecast accuracy evidence.

prediction.formula: Frozen standardized ridge logistic p=sigmoid(intercept+coefficient dot standardized[B11,qRewrite32]); all-512 development coefficients, scales and intercept fixed. Compare byte-identical retained8 and TT008 coefficients.
prediction.q_rewrite: 32 independent original-packet writer reads A, each followed by one fresh read of its own successor under independent B. Success fraction of32 B reads.
prediction.direct: Original protected packet under the first8 shared B environments; frozen retained8 predictor.
prediction.forecast_timing: Commit every record/regime measurement and all three probabilities, commit all304 forecast blocks, verify every transitive evidence hash, then write the global forecast seal before any scientific continuation. A resumed continuation must verify the same seal and inputs.

forcing.seed_contract: SHA256 of compact JSON [namespace,stage,*record_key,index,purpose,channel], first16bytes little-endian PCG64. Measurement and future namespaces disjoint; injury/forcing channels disjoint. Future indices15..32 with purpose writer, then33 with purpose evaluation.
forcing.disturbance: Each read: fresh body,24 uniformly sampled distinct non-port injured cells, all three2x2 ports protected. Fresh independent draws across reads. Read2048 steps; settle1024; last32 means; birth_sd .05; noise .02; dt .2; clipped native state [-2,2].
forcing.regime_coupling: Paired regimes use the same base draws and injury. Matched copies cue0 birth and ongoing noise to cue1; independent retains both. Each regime uses its own propagated packets. Acquisition stays matched.
forcing.primary_conditions: Matched measurement with matched continuation/terminal; independent measurement with independent continuation/terminal. No cross-regime recalibration.

outcome.endpoint: Native task success in a fresh terminal body reading the g32 outgoing packet, after18 full original-writer rebuilds from g14. All four task-aligned cue/port means strictly>.25. Terminal read outgoing packet discarded; failure earlier in lineage does not stop a path.
outcome.continuation_audit: One key-only SHA256-ranked record per block, both regimes, every one of18 rewrites and terminal read. Flat path propagates its own packets; bodies,windows,outgoing must be bitwise equal.
outcome.claims: Terminal reconstruction, not uninterrupted function, autonomous apparatus maintenance, a universal probability law or RDT-specific novelty.

analysis.unit: Acquisition block; relatives, regimes and comparator predictions remain paired.
analysis.primary_score: Per record squared probability error, mean across all64 records, then equal mean across blocks. Compute four paired block contrasts: rival loss minus fixed32 loss, two rivals x two regimes.
analysis.interval: For each contrast, mean +/- t.ppf(.975,n-1)*sample_block_sd/sqrt(n). Support that contrast if lower>margin; reject the stated advantage if upper<=margin; otherwise unresolved.
analysis.joint_rule: Support the full two-regime reduction only if all four lower limits exceed their margins. This is an intersection-union claim; no independence assumed, and nominal global false-support probability is bounded by the largest per-test alpha under valid block-t inference. Individual intervals are not simultaneously95%; any failed component narrows the claim, with no familywise rejection error claim.
analysis.diagnostics: Ten fixed probability bins [0,.1,...,1], include1 in last bin; observed versus predicted means and Brier. Conditional loss is equal-block loss mass divided by stratum mass, equivalent to pooled conditional loss because all blocks have64 records. Additive stratum contrasts average per-block sums/64, including zero for empty strata, and reconstruct the primary contrast. Report counts and contributing blocks. No fitted calibration slopes or subgroup decision gate.
analysis.rejection_interpretation: A statistical rejection concerns this fixed ordinary forecast reduction in the specified domain. Numerical failure or insufficient sample precision is an execution or feasibility result, not rejection of RDT.
analysis.completion: All304 blocks and all64 records per block in both regimes required for scientific verdict. Numerical/resource failure or incomplete data yields execution incomplete, never an inferential rejection. No partial scientific score is published by status updates.

planning.source: Fixed-budget leave-one-block-out probabilities and already exposed g32 labels from eight blocks34000..34007, each64 records. No nested-selected probabilities.
planning.formula: Smallest n with sqrt(n)*(mean gain-margin)>=(t.ppf(1-alpha,n-1)+normal.ppf(.8))*SD. Evaluate alpha .025 (inherited) and .0125 (95% simultaneous one-sided Bonferroni sensitivity across four contrasts).
planning.variance_sensitivity: SD*sqrt(7/chi2.ppf(.05,7)); normal-theory95% upper SD sensitivity, not guaranteed under arbitrary block distributions.
planning.feasibility: The parent256-block screen failed and remains failed. Amendment1 permits304 blocks at the newly measured cost, contingent on complete runner qualification and resource admission. No automatic increase after future outcomes.
planning.limits: Only eight exposed blocks; prior family/budget selection and uncertain effect sizes can make plug-in planning optimistic. No independent-noise future labels exist here; its power and joint four-comparison power are unknown. No novel sample size is called guaranteed or confirmatory.

resources.scientific_launch: Not started by preparation or qualification. The completed qualification and a fresh CPU/disk admission must be bound into an explicit detached job.
resources.phase_transition: Once the complete outcome job is launched, measurement to sealed continuation to final audit/analysis is one authorized job; no new study is started.

claim_boundary: The fixed32 fresh precision screen remains passed; the failed variable-budget selector and earlier RDT reductions retain their verdicts. Excluded TT018 and paired-continuation statuses/outcomes are not inspected. This amendment changes resource feasibility prospectively; it is not a biological or mathematical law.

amendment.rationale: User authorized preparing a304-block amendment after the exact-reader speed benchmark.304 is the fixed-model matched-regime plug-in count; the old cap failure remains a recorded result. This is a deliberate resource revision, not a retrospective pass.
amendment.uncertainty: Eight exposed blocks inform planning after family/budget selection. Upper-SD sensitivity needs960 blocks; independent-noise and joint four-comparison power are unknown.304 is a bounded informative test, not guaranteed80% joint power.

acquisition.teaching: E016 consistent regime: positive cue and coordinated negative cue use the same base draws with opposite polarity; four paired opposite-rule founders, four recipients. Fresh namespace in every teaching, injury and renewal stream.
acquisition.boundary: g14 outgoing packet and eleven TT008 features. Matched acquisition noise; original writer except four declared historical schedules. Causally discarded holding steps remain omitted as in prior verified replay.
acquisition.audit: Separate flat teaching replay for every block; four-history flat-reader and writer checks at g1,g3,g14 for founder0/recipient0; sparse independent transfer for every g14 record. Benchmark reconstructs exposed block34000 and requires exact archived four-history g14 packets and expression.

selection.rule: All64 records are enrolled. The minimum key-only SHA256 rank chooses one full continuation audit per block; this does not select observations for analysis.

recovery.commit: Exclusive attempt directories with raw arrays,receipts and a durable commit manifest. Inputs, models, keys, forcing law and hashes are fixed.
recovery.resume: Explicit manual resume only. Preserve every invocation and incomplete attempt; verify and reuse complete commits. Recompute an incomplete logical unit only under its identical frozen seed/key, never with replacement seeds. More than one committed attempt for a unit is an error.
recovery.run_lock: Exclusive filesystem lock prevents simultaneous writers to a run.
recovery.wall_budget: Fixed UTC deadline20 days after original scientific launch, including downtime; resume does not reset it.
recovery.outcome_barrier: A cohort-wide forecast seal is mandatory before opening a continuation unit; every referenced block and record must be complete and hash-valid. No resume can replace the seal or refit forecasts.

qualification.lightweight: Tests of stream separation, exact terminal endpoint, complete-cohort checks, paired block inference, calibration empty strata, commit tampering/duplicates/partial attempts, failure/restart guards and the pre-future barrier. Reduced-step fixtures are labeled as such.
qualification.native: Replay the previously exposed legacy acquisition block34000 throughg14 and require byte-identical archived packets,bodies and response means. Separately run the entire production orchestration on two synthetic blocks with two records each: all four packet classes and history labels, both task rules, both noise regimes, full32-probe measurements, global seal,18 rewrites,fresh terminal reads,flat audits and independent final analysis.
qualification.untouched: No production namespace blocks or future outcomes are generated during qualification.
qualification.detach: Native qualification has an850-second planning estimate and a1800-second cap; detach, one startup check, no automatic polling.
